verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI documents access to the messages exchanged during agent runs, and a community user reports it can serialize and deserialize conversations as JSON. That gives conversation data an open-format export path, and the model-agnostic design lowers lock-in. However, there is no documented 'export everything and leave' capability. missing for 10: first-party docs showing JSON export of message history, export coverage beyond conversations (traces, eval datasets, Logfire data), a documented migration or exit path, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Pydantic AI provides access to messages exchanged during an agent run.
Pydantic AI is model-agnostic and has built-in support for multiple model providers
